metadata.title: Cathie Wood Dumps $27.2 Million of Palantir Stock After 43% Rally

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Palantir Technologies (NASDAQ:PLTR) is becoming one of the most closely watched AI stocks on Wall Street, but Cathie Wood's latest trade is raising a different question: Is the stock's explosive rally getting too far ahead of itself?
ARK Invest sold 156,110 Palantir shares worth about $27.2 million on Aug. 21, according to the firm's latest trading activity.
At the same time, Wood's firm bought $27.5 million of SpaceX shares, creating an interesting contrast between two of the market's most prominent AI-related growth stories.
The Palantir sale comes after a major advance in the stock. Shares closed around $179.94 in the latest data, up roughly 43% from the $125.65 level recorded before the company's Aug. 3 earnings report.
That rally was backed by numbers that were difficult for investors to ignore.
